show.description: Isha, a kind and simple girl, is betrayed by her jealous step-sister Naina, who drugs her and tries to ruin her reputation. When her life falls apart, a simple security guard named Aadi stands by her side and marries her. What Isha doesn’t know is that Aadi is actually Aditya Shekhawat, a powerful billionaire hiding his identity. As secrets come out and enemies confess, love and truth give Isha the respect and happiness she deserves
